decisions_log.decision: AUTONOMOUS then OPERATOR-CONFIRMED: design changed from the plan's prescribed prefix-max to a disjoint cover in _linkage_index
decisions_log.notes: The plan section 4 prescribes 'prefix-max over ends (carry an argmax)'. Measured an alternative with IDENTICAL output and one third the blast radius, then put both to the operator rather than swapping silently. Enabling premise P-10, executed: _linkage_index's output reaches _classify_linkage -> _first_intersecting_symbol and NOTHING else (apply.py:316-327, check.py:293-347; repo-wide grep finds no other importer), so normalizing the producer is safe. Prefix-max needs a 3rd return value -> signature change -> drags in check.py:293-294 = 3 files. The cover keeps the 2-tuple signature = 1 file, and it restores the precondition the docstring already declared rather than working around it. Measured equivalent: 48 000 disjoint probes 0 mismatches, 48 000 overlapping probes 0 wrong for both designs (pre-fix wrong on 12 123 = 25.3%). Operator selected the cover.

decisions_log.decision: D-2 (NEW, operator): the overlap tie-break is FIRST-BY-START, ties by declaration order
decisions_log.notes: Surfaced because the plan's counterexample does NOT disambiguate it - only BIG_ARRAY covers 0x5000. Nested ranges and MAC aliases do. First-by-start is what the function's own NAME (_first_intersecting_symbol) and docstring ('the first intersection') already promise, so the fix makes the code honest rather than redefining it. The rejected arm - innermost / most-specific attribution - is a different FEATURE and was carried to BACKLOG-CODE.md P3 rather than smuggled in.
